failures_and_root_causes.issue: Half-recorded recovery over-counted zero-order pending DB stubs as critical unmatched-fill exposure.
failures_and_root_causes.root_cause: list_half_recorded_arbs returned every active arb with fewer than two order rows without separating no-order/no-notional stubs from filled one-leg exposure.

failures_and_root_causes.issue: Closed half-recorded rows could leave stale open recovery incidents.
failures_and_root_causes.root_cause: recovery did not resolve open half-recorded incidents whose arbs were no longer active blockers.

failures_and_root_causes.issue: True one-leg filled arbs remain unresolved.
failures_and_root_causes.root_cause: 32 pending arbs each have one filled leg and require manual venue/exposure reconciliation; these were intentionally not auto-resolved.

failures_and_root_causes.issue: Stuck-trade recovery reported 35 errors per run.
failures_and_root_causes.root_cause: Recovery persistence used an uncast $2 parameter in multiple Postgres type contexts, producing asyncpg inconsistent type inference errors.

failures_and_root_causes.issue: Stuck-trade recovery tried to process closed arbs and briefly changed three closed rows to filled during live verification.
failures_and_root_causes.root_cause: closed was missing from list_stuck_arbs terminal status filter; code now treats closed as terminal and the three rows were restored to closed with an audit note.

failures_and_root_causes.issue: A half-recorded one-leg filled arb could derive to filled if the SQL error did not stop persistence.
failures_and_root_causes.root_cause: _derive_arb_status_from_legs did not fail closed for fewer than two persisted legs with a FILLED leg; it now leaves those as manual blockers.

fixes_made: ExecutionStore.list_half_recorded_arbs now excludes closed terminal rows and includes filled_leg_count plus filled_notional.
Added ExecutionStore.mark_no_exposure_half_recorded_arbs_failed to close only zero-order/no-exposure stubs as failed with recovery notes.
Added ExecutionStore.resolve_half_recorded_incidents to resolve incidents for auto-closed no-exposure stubs.
Added ExecutionStore.resolve_stale_half_recorded_incidents to clear open half-recorded incidents no longer present in active recovery output.
reconcile_half_recorded_arbs now partitions no-exposure stubs from exposure-bearing blockers and emits critical incidents only for the latter.
Recovery incident metadata now includes filled_leg_count and filled_notional so operators can prioritize real exposure.
Added shared effective_critical_incident_count helper to expand half-recorded summary incidents to their underlying blocker count.
Readiness incident gate now reports critical_incident_count=32 and blocks with "32 critical incidents remain unresolved" instead of one terse summary incident.
Profitability validator now counts half-recorded summary incidents by underlying blocker count, so critical_incidents=32 and the blocked reason is explicit.
Phase 5 bootstrap readiness override now only applies to collecting_evidence; blocked and not_profitable verdicts fail closed.
Stuck-trade recovery now leaves single filled-leg arbs unchanged as manual exposure blockers instead of deriving them to filled.
Stuck-trade recovery persistence casts the status parameter as text to avoid asyncpg/Postgres inconsistent type inference errors.
Stuck-trade recovery now excludes closed arbs from the stuck set and treats closed as terminal.
Restored ARB-000053, ARB-000056, and ARB-000203 to closed after verifying the prior recovery note recorded original=closed.
Added GET /api/recovery/half-recorded as a read-only, fail-closed endpoint that groups exact half-recorded blockers by canonical_id and always returns allow_auto_trade=false.
Added timestamp-safe serialization for recovery blocker rows.
PortfolioMonitor now includes arb_id on engine-derived open positions and uses stale_hedge:{arb_id} violation IDs for execution-specific operator action.
Ops dashboard refresh now fetches /api/recovery/half-recorded and stores it under recovery.halfRecorded.
Ops Audit page now shows Live trading blocked when readiness is false and adds a Half-recorded exposure blockers panel.

notes: Fetched origin/main and confirmed local main matched origin/main before this continuation.

Added a second hardening pass so readiness/profitability expand half-recorded summary incidents to their underlying blocker count.

Restored ARB-000053, ARB-000056, and ARB-000203 to closed after the prior faulty live recovery cycle changed them to filled; restoration was guarded by recovery_notes proving original=closed.
